name: promptfoo
desc: Test prompts, agents, and RAG with declarative configs; red-teaming and CI/CD built in. Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.

name: DeepEval
desc: "Pytest for LLMs" — a large library of metrics you assert on in unit tests.

name: Ragas
desc: Metrics focused on RAG and agent pipelines; strong on faithfulness and context quality.

name: OpenAI Evals
desc: The original framework plus an open registry of benchmarks for evaluating LLMs and systems.

name: Inspect
desc: A rigorous evaluation framework from the UK AI Safety Institute; first-class agent and tool-use support.

name: Giskard
desc: Open-source testing for LLM agents; scans for vulnerabilities and quality issues.

name: Opik
desc: Trace, evaluate, and monitor LLM/RAG/agentic apps with automated evals and dashboards.

name: Langfuse
desc: Open-source LLM engineering platform: evals, observability, prompt management, datasets.

name: Phoenix
desc: AI observability and evaluation, OpenTelemetry-based (by Arize).

name: TruLens
desc: Evaluation and tracking for LLM experiments and agents, built around feedback functions.

name: LangWatch
desc: A platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing.

name: UpTrain
desc: 20+ preconfigured checks plus root-cause analysis on failures.

name: Deepchecks
desc: Continuous validation for models and data, extended to LLM apps.

name: Evidently
desc: Open-source ML/LLM observability with 100+ metrics for evaluation and monitoring.

name: Weave
desc: A lightweight toolkit for tracking and evaluating LLM apps (by Weights & Biases).

name: Helicone
desc: Open-source LLM observability; one line of code to monitor, evaluate, and experiment.

name: OpenLLMetry
desc: Open-source GenAI observability built on OpenTelemetry.

name: Langtrace
desc: OpenTelemetry-based end-to-end tracing, evals, and metrics for LLM apps and vector DBs.

name: AgentOps
desc: Agent monitoring, cost tracking, and benchmarking; integrates with CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, AutoGen, and more.

name: NeMo Guardrails
desc: Programmable guardrails for LLM conversational systems (by NVIDIA).

name: Guardrails AI
desc: Add input/output validators and structured guarantees to LLMs.

name: LLM Guard
desc: A security toolkit for LLM interactions (PII, toxicity, injection).

name: Rebuff
desc: A self-hardening prompt-injection detector.

name: SWE-bench
desc: Can agents resolve real GitHub issues? The de facto coding-agent benchmark.

name: τ-bench (tau-bench)
desc: Tool-agent-user interaction in realistic customer-service settings (by Sierra).

name: AgentBench
desc: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating LLMs as agents across 8 environments (ICLR'24).

name: WebArena
desc: A realistic, self-hostable web environment for autonomous agents.

name: VisualWebArena
desc: WebArena extended to multimodal, visually-grounded web tasks.

name: BrowserGym
desc: A Gym environment for web-automation agents (by ServiceNow).

name: OSWorld
desc: Benchmarking multimodal agents on open-ended tasks in real computer environments (NeurIPS 2024).

name: AndroidWorld
desc: An environment and benchmark for autonomous mobile agents (by Google Research).

name: MLE-bench
desc: How well do agents perform at machine-learning engineering? (by OpenAI).

name: ToolBench
desc: Training, serving, and evaluating LLMs for tool use (ICLR'24 spotlight).

name: EvalGate
desc: Prompt and agent regression CI as a GitHub Action; the build fails when your prompt gets dumber, with PR delta comments.

name: VoiceEval
desc: Evaluation for voice agents; catches what text evals miss: mis-hearing, missing confirmation, latency, barge-in.

name: Agentrace
desc: Observability for Claude Code subagents; reads session transcripts and flags results you shouldn't trust.

name: AnswerProof
desc: Verifiable, tamper-evident receipts for RAG answers (Merkle inclusion proofs + Ed25519 signatures).

name: Agent QA
desc: Application-level regression testing for software produced by coding agents, with persistent web/mobile tests and retained failure evidence; it does not score agent trajectories and is source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2, converting to Apache-2.0 two years after each release.

name: LLM Datasets
desc: A curated list of datasets and tools for post-training and evaluation.
